messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-hot-route saturation. 95% GPU utilization; queue length ~320; p90 latency 1.9s. Spike originates from /v1/embeddings (route_id: embeddings-hot). Paging on-call: @alice_ml_oncall
alice_ml_oncall: On it. Looking at traces now. Any customer-visible errors? :eyes:
dina_support: Dina here — support queue has 6 tickets mentioning slow embedding jobs and timeouts since 11:02 UTC. Two enterprise customers impacted (acct: AcmeCorp, acct: Nimbus). No data loss.
alice_ml_oncall: Confirmed increased 429s for embeddings route. Chat and rerank not elevated. Likely traffic skew from a batch job hitting embeddings route without KV caching.
ben_sre: Recommending immediate per-route throttle for embeddings to protect control plane and other routes. Suggest: reduce embeddings QPS to 25% for non-enterprise tokens, keep enterprise SLA unaffected.
charlie_prod: Agreed. Prioritize chat + critical embeddings for enterprise. We can't afford rerank being high cost — consider disabling rerank for free tier temporarily.
eve_obs: Metrics/alerts updated: created dashboard filter for route=embeddings-hot and grouped by api_key tier. Sending link: https://internal/obs/d/embeddings-hot
frank_engineer: If we gate the embeddings endpoint at edge we can shed load quickly. I can push a rate-limit rule to the router. Command I'd run:
```sh
# apply temporary route quota
routerctl apply --route embeddings-hot --tier non-enterprise --qps 8
routerctl apply --route embeddings-hot --tier enterprise --qps 200
```
alice_ml_oncall: Do it. Also please add a header so clients get 429 with Retry-After. Notify support.
frank_engineer: Pushing now. /deploy to edge-ratelimiter
deploy-bot: deploy job 8853 started by frank_engineer
deploy-bot: deploy job 8853 succeeded in 28s
frank_engineer: Done. Rule active. Non-enterprise embeddings qps=8, enterprise unchanged. 429 + Retry-After header should be returned.
ben_sre: Also applying a token-level quota tweak for the most abusive API keys: setting token cap to 10k tokens/min for non-enterprise group.
charlie_prod: I'm enabling route-level fallback: if embeddings qps breached, route will fall back to cached-embedding variant (model: embed-v1-small) for non-critical requests.
alice_ml_oncall: Monitoring p95/p99 now. Initial queue dropped from 320 -> 42 within 60s. Latency p90 improved to 650ms.
dina_support: Notifying affected customers: sent templated update to AcmeCorp and Nimbus. Logged INC-4532 and INC-4533.
frank_engineer: Also disabled 'rerank-lite' on non-enterprise tokens for the next 30m to free capacity.
eve_obs: Alerting: error rate for embeddings dropped 429->18% (was 62%). Chat unchanged. Visuals in dashboard.
alice_ml_oncall: Good mitigation. Next steps: 1) Keep throttle for 15m, 2) run canary to see if traffic normalizes, 3) prepare rollback plan if enterprise impact appears.
ben_sre: I'll stay on call for next 20m. If everything stable, we'll gradually relax limit in 5m increments.
charlie_prod: Postmortem owners: alice_ml_oncall + frank_engineer. Tagging product for post-incident customer follow-up.
alice_ml_oncall: Handoff to ben_sre at 12:07 UTC. If anything spikes, page #eng-oncall as escalation. Closing thread when metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
